sentences.japanese: 貴殿はテニス肘と診断されました。温かいお湯に腕をつけてください。
sentences.english: You have tennis elbow. Soak your arm in warm water.

sentences.japanese: 肘が痛むんだよ。病院に行こうかな。
sentences.english: My elbow really hurts. I guess I should go to a hospital.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は両膝に肘をのせた。
sentences.english: She put her elbows on her knees.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は私の肘をちょっと押した。
sentences.english: She gave my elbow a little jog.

sentences.japanese: テニスで肘を痛めました。
sentences.english: I hurt my elbow playing tennis.
